tools.name: pax.market_search
tools.description: Search PredictAsiaX markets by keyword or category. Returns paginated list with prices, volume, status.

tools.name: pax.market_get
tools.description: Get full detail for a single market: title, question, prices, volume, open interest, resolution rules, template.

tools.name: pax.market_orderbook
tools.description: Read top-of-book bid/ask ladder for a market. Depth capped at 20 levels each side.

tools.name: pax.market_price_history
tools.description: Time-series probability history for a market (LTTB-sampled). Range 1h through 90d.

tools.name: pax.probability_movers
tools.description: Return markets whose YES probability moved the most in a window. Ranked by |delta|.

tools.name: pax.markets_top_volume
tools.description: 24h volume leaderboard. Useful for surfacing hot markets.

tools.name: pax.category_list
tools.description: List all market categories with counts and 24h volume.

tools.name: pax.portfolio_read
tools.description: Read the user's current positions, mark-price PNL, unrealized PnL, and USDT balances.

tools.name: pax.portfolio_history
tools.description: Historical PnL curve (realized + unrealized) for the user, sampled daily.

tools.name: pax.balance_get
tools.description: USDT free + reserved balance for a subaccount.

tools.name: pax.positions_list
tools.description: List open positions across markets with size + entry price + current mark.

tools.name: pax.subaccount_list
tools.description: List all subaccounts for a user with kind, currency, and balance.

tools.name: pax.place_order
tools.description: Submit a new order. Requires Idempotency-Key header on the transport. Tier caps enforced server-side.

tools.name: pax.cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an open or partially-filled order.

tools.name: pax.cancel_all_orders
tools.description: Bulk cancel all open orders for a user + (optional) market. Atomic.

tools.name: pax.orders_open
tools.description: List currently-open orders for the user (status IN open, partially_filled).

tools.name: pax.orders_history
tools.description: Historical orders (filled + cancelled + expired) for the user, paginated.

tools.name: pax.fee_estimate
tools.description: Estimate the taker fee for a hypothetical order under the PAX Adaptive Fee Curve (PAF): 8-25 bps depending on price extremity, plus optional additive partner fee (0-100 bps).

tools.name: pax.mm_stipend_estimate
tools.description: Real-time LQF stipend forecast for a market maker on one market this epoch. Returns projected payout at 00:15 UTC based on snapshots seen so far.

tools.name: pax.mm_stipend_history
tools.description: Historical LQF stipend payouts for a market maker. Optional market_id filter, default limit 30.

tools.name: pax.liquidity_leaderboard
tools.description: Public leaderboard of top LQF stipend earners over a rolling window. Optional market_id filter.

tools.name: pax.subaccount_create
tools.description: Create a new subaccount under the primary user account.

tools.name: pax.subaccount_transfer
tools.description: Transfer USDT between subaccounts under the same primary user.

tools.name: pax.subaccount_close
tools.description: Close (freeze) a subaccount. Rejects if positions/balance/open orders remain.

tools.name: pax.composer_templates_list
tools.description: List market templates available for opening new markets (crypto price binary, sports, election, etc).

tools.name: pax.composer_template_get
tools.description: Read a single market template with resolution rules + example config.

tools.name: pax.composer_proposal_submit
tools.description: Submit a new market proposal from a template. Enters admin review queue.

tools.name: pax.resolution_evidence
tools.description: Return the evidence + sources used to resolve a market.

tools.name: pax.mm_quote_post
tools.description: Post a two-sided MM quote to a market. TTL 1-3600s. Requires designated MM status for rebate.

tools.name: pax.mm_quotes_list
tools.description: List active MM quotes for a market.

tools.name: pax.rfq_create
tools.description: Create an RFQ (request for quote) — asks MMs to bid for a specific size.

tools.name: pax.rfq_accept
tools.description: Accept a specific RFQ quote — atomically fills at the quoted price.

tools.name: pax.builder_me
tools.description: Return the current builder profile: tier, apps count, 30d volume + fee revenue, verified status.

tools.name: pax.builder_apps_list
tools.description: List apps registered under the current builder profile.

tools.name: pax.builder_apikeys_list
tools.description: List API keys for a specific app (metadata only — secrets never returned).

tools.name: pax.tier_status
tools.description: Read the current builder tier + auto-graduation progress (30d volume + days remaining + abuse flags).

tools.name: pax.fee_ledger_read
tools.description: Read fee_ledger entries attributed to the current builder — 4-way split shares + additive builder fees.

tools.name: pax.webhook_endpoints_list
tools.description: List webhook endpoints registered under an app.

tools.name: pax.webhook_create
tools.description: Register a new webhook endpoint. Returns whsec_<hex> ONCE for signing verification.

tools.name: pax.webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Read recent webhook delivery attempts for an endpoint (status, HTTP code, retry count).

tools.name: pax.access_request_create
tools.description: Submit an access-request for a builder track (no email required — provide Telegram / Signal / Discord / Matrix / X DM handle).

tools.name: pax.access_request_status
tools.description: Check status of a pending access request by its request_id.

tools.name: pax.sandbox_agent_examples
tools.description: End-to-end examples for building an AI agent against PAX — sandbox keys, minimal flows.

tools.name: pax.health
tools.description: MCP server health + protocol version + D1 reachability + upstream latency.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "pax.builder_apikeys_list" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List API keys for a specific app (metadata only — secrets never returned).
